senses.gloss:
गल् €1 P. (गलति, जगाल, अगालीत्, गलितुम्, गलित)
—1 To drop, drip, ooze, trickle; जलमिव गलत्युपदिष्टम् K. 103;
 अच्छकपोलमूलगलितैः (अश्रुभिः) Amaru. 29, 96; Bv. 2. 21; R. 19. 22.
—2 To drop or fall down; शरदमच्छगलद्वसनोपमा Śi. 6. 42, 9. 75;
 प्रतोदा जगलुः Bk. 14. 99, 17. 87. गलद्धम्मिल्ल Gīt. 2;
 R. 7. 10; Me. 46.
—3 To vanish, disappear, pass away, be removed; गलति मध्यरात्रे
 Dk.; शैशवेन सह गलति गुरुजनस्नेहः K. 289; विद्यां प्रमादगलितामिव
 चिन्तयामि C. P. 1; Bh. 2. 44; Bk. 5. 43; R. 3. 70.
—4 To eat, swallow (connected with गॄ). ━Caus. or €10 U. (p. p.
 गलित)
—1 To pour out.
—2 To filter, strain.
—3 To flow (Ā.). —4 To fuse, liquefy, dissolve, melt. ━With {@निस्@} to
 ooze or flow out, trickle down; निर्गलिताम्बुगर्भं शरद्घनं नार्दति
 चातकोऽपि R. 5. 17.
━{@पर्या@} to drop down; Bk. 2. 4.

गलः [गल्-भक्षणे बा˚ करणे अच्]
—1 The throat, neck; शितिना गलेन विलसन्मरीचिना Ki. 12. 23; न
 गरलं गले कस्तूरीयम्; cf. अजागलस्तन; Bh. 1. 64; Amaru. 88.
—2 The resin of the Śāla tree.
—3 A kind of musical instrument.
—4 A rope.
—5 A kind of fish.
—6 A large kind of grass (बृहत्काश).
.━{@Comp.@}: गलाङ्कुरः, गलोद्भवः, गलौघः, गलकम्बलः, गलगण्डः, गलग्रहः, गलग्रहणम्, गलचर्मन्, गलद्वारम्, गलमेखला, गलवार्त, गलविद्रधिः, गलव्रतः, गलशुण्डिका, गलशुण्डी, गलस्तनी, गलहस्तः, गलहस्तित

गल्लः The cheek; especially, the part of the cheek near the corners
 of the mouth; Pt. 1. 123. (Rhetoricians consider this word to be ग्राम्य
 or vulgar; cf. the instance given in K. P. 7:− ताम्बूलभृतगल्लोऽयं
 भल्लं जल्पति मानुषः; but cf. Bhavabhūtiʼs use:− पातालप्रतिमल्लगल्लविवरप्रक्षिप्तसप्तार्णवम् Māl. 5. 22).
.━{@Comp.@}: गल्लचातुरी

—1 Flowing, liquefying.
—2 Dropping.
—3 A flux.
गलः + -अङ्कुरः a particular disease of the throat (inflammation).
गलः + -उद्भवः the tuft of hair on the neck of a horse.
गलः + -ओघः tumor in the throat.
गलः + -कम्बलः a bullʼs dewlap.

गलः + -गण्डः
—1 enlargement of the glands of the neck.
—2 goitre.

गलः + -ग्रहः, -ग्रहणम्
—1 seizing by the throat, throttling, smothering.
—2 a kind of disease; Mb. 12. 303. 5.
—3 N. of certain days in the dark fortnight of a month:− i. e. the
 4th, 7th, 8th, 9th, 13th and the three following days.
—4 a day on which a course of study is commenced, but immediately preceding
 a day on which it is prohibited.
—5 study, begun but immediately interrupted.

गलः + -ग्रहः, -ग्रहणम्
—1 seizing by the throat, throttling, smothering.
—2 a kind of disease; Mb. 12. 303. 5.
—3 N. of certain days in the dark fortnight of a month:− i. e. the
 4th, 7th, 8th, 9th, 13th and the three following days.
—4 a day on which a course of study is commenced, but immediately preceding
 a day on which it is prohibited.
—5 study, begun but immediately interrupted.
गलः + -चर्मन् n. the gullet, throat.
गलः + -द्वारम् the mouth.
गलः + -मेखला a necklace.

गलः + -वार्त a.
—1 safe in the work of the throat, able to eat much and digest it, healthy,
 sound; दृश्यन्ते चैव तीर्थेषु गलवार्तास्तपस्विनः Pt. 3, v. l.
—2 a parasite.
गलः + -विद्रधिः tumor and abscess in the throat.
गलः + -व्रतः a peacock.
गलः + -शुण्डिका the uvula.
गलः + -शुण्डी swelling of the glands of the neck.
गलः + -स्तनी (also गलेस्तनी) a she-goat.

गलः + -हस्तः
—1 seizing by the throat, throttling, collaring; अनिच्छन्गलहस्तेन
 ताभिर्निर्वासितस्ततः Ks. 4. 68.
—2 an arrow with a crescent-shaped head; cf. अर्धचन्द्र.
गलः + -हस्तित a. seized by the throat, throttled, strangled; अर्धेन्दुलीलैर्गलहस्तितेव N. 6. 25.

गलकः [गल् बा˚ वुन्]
—1 The throat, the neck.
—2 A kind of fish.

—1 A wine-glass.
—2 Sapphire; see गल्वर्क below.

गलनम् [गल् भावे ल्युट्]
—1 Oozing, trickling, dripping.
—2 Leaking.
—3 Melting, fusing.
—4 Falling down or off.

गालनम् [गल् णिच्-भावे ल्युट्]
—1 Straining (fluids).
—2 Fusing, liquefying, melting.
—3 Reviling; cf. com. on Mb. 12. 68. 31.

गलन्तिका, गलन्ती
—1 A small pitcher.
—2 A small water-jar with a hole in the bottom from which the water drops
 upon the object of worship (an image, Liṅga, Tulasī &c.) placed below.

गलन्तिका, गलन्ती
—1 A small pitcher.
—2 A small water-jar with a hole in the bottom from which the water drops
 upon the object of worship (an image, Liṅga, Tulasī &c.) placed below.

गलित p. p. [गल्-क्त]
—1 Dropped or fallen down.
—2 Melted.
—3 Oozed, flowing.
—4 Lost, vanished, deprived.
—5 Untied, got loose.
—6 Emptied, leaked away.
—7 Filtered.
—8 Decayed, impaired.
—9 Decreased, exhausted; गलितविभवाश्चार्थिषु नृपाः Bh. 2. 44.
.━{@Comp.@}: गलितकुष्ठम्, गलितनखदन्त, गलितदन्त, गलितनयन, गलितयौवन, गलितवयस्

गालित a.
—1 Strained.
—2 Distilled.
—3 Melted, fused.

गलित + -कुष्ठम् advanced or incurable leprosy when the fingers and toes
 fall off; also गुलत्कुष्ठम्

गलित + -नखदन्त a. one who has lost his claws and teeth; वृद्धो
 गलितनखदन्तो न कथं विश्वासभूमिः H. 1.
गलित + -दन्त a. toothless.
गलित + -नयन a. one who has lost his eyes, blind.

गलित + -यौवन a. one who has lost the bloom or charm of youth, grown
 old; गलितयौवना कामिनी Bh. 2. 56.

गलित + -वयस् a. being in the decline of age, in declining years;
 गलितवयसामिक्ष्वाकूणामिदं हि कुलव्रतम् R. 3. 70.
गलितकः A kind of dance, gesticulation; V. 4. 56, 57.

—1 A multitude of throats.
—2 A quantity of a particular kind of grass or of ropes made of it.

गलेगण्डः A kind of bird, (so called from the pendulous fleshy purse
 hanging from its throat); Adjutant bird.
गलानिलः A prawn or shrimp.
गलिः [गडि, डस्य लः] A strong but lazy bull; see गडि.

गालिः f. [गल्-इन्] Abuse, abusive or foul language; ददतु
 ददतु गालीर्गालिमन्तो भवन्तो वयमपि तदभावाद्गालिदानेऽसमर्थाः Bh. 3. 133;
 Rāj. T. 6. 157.
.━{@Comp.@}: गालिदानम्, गालिप्रदानम्

गलुः m. A kind of gem (चन्द्रकान्त); मसारगल्वर्कमयैर्विभङ्गैर्विभूषितं
 हेमनिबद्धचकम् Mb. 12. 46. 33.

गल्दः, -ल्दा Ved.
—1 Speech.
—2 Straining.

गल्दः, -ल्दा Ved.
—1 Speech.
—2 Straining.
गल्भ् €1 Ā. (गल्भते, गल्भित) To be bold or confident.

गल्भ a.
—1 Bold, confident, audacious.
—2 Proud, haughty.
गल्लः + -चातुरी a small round pillow to put underneath the cheek.

गल्लर्कः A vessel for drinking spirituous liquor; एवं बृहत्तरे
 गल्लर्कप्रमाणे कुले जातः Mk. 8; गल्लर्कशतपरिवृतः &c.

—1 Crystal.
—2 Lapis lazuli; see गलुः; Mb. 7. 16. 54.
—3 A goblet, a vessel for drinking spirituous liquor; मसारगल्वर्कमुखः
 Rām. 3. 43. 29.
गल्ह् €1 Ā. (गल्हते, गल्हित) To blame, censure.

—1 The Lodhra tree.
—2 A kind of ebony.
—3 N. of a sage, a pupil of Viśvāmitra (said in Hariv. to be his son).
गालिः + -दानम्, -प्रदानम् Reviling; Rāj. T. 7. 304.
गालिः + -दानम्, -प्रदानम् Reviling; Rāj. T. 7. 304.
गालिनी A particular position of the fingers.

गालोडित a.
—1 Drunk, intoxicated.
—2 Sick, diseased.
—3 Foolish.
गालोडित + .{@-तम्@} Examination; investigation.
गालोड्यम् The seed of a lotus.
